title: dispatch_one clones args before every handler call
description: In kith-jmap/src/lib.rs dispatch_one(), both owner and peer handler paths call args.clone() before passing to the handler (lines 427, 413). The handler receives owned args but the caller only needs args for ResultReference recording. Restructuring to pass args by value (consuming it) would eliminate the clone in the common single-method-call case. Impact is bounded by max_size_request (10MB) but still wasteful per request.
